title: An-Nazi'at 79:9-16 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 23 (Pupil PDF worksheet: An-Nazi'at 79:9-16 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 23. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: أَبْصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٌۭ (٩) يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ (١٠) أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًۭا نَّخِرَةًۭ (١١) قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًۭا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌۭ (١٢) فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ (١٣) فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ (١٤) هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ (١٥) إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى (١٦)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?
Even if we should be decayed bones?
They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."
Indeed, it will be but one shout,
And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.
Has there reached you the story of Moses? -
When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Idgham with ghunnah: tanween into ن
Maddah sign: munfasil when joined to إِذْ (79:16)
4 or 5 counts joined; 2 if you stop

questions.q: Chunk and link An-Nazi'at 79:9-16 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 79:9-16 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 79:9-16 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Find two heavy letters and one itbaq letter in 79:9 to 16.
questions.a: Heavy: خ in خَٰشِعَةٌ, ق in ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ; itbaq: ظ in عِظَٰمًۭا, ط in طُوًى.

questions.q: Why might the story of Musa begin here, straight after the denial of the Hereafter?
questions.a: To show that those who deny and transgress, like Pharaoh, are punished: a lesson for the deniers.
A) the sacred valley of Tuwa. 79:16: 'When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa.'

questions.q: Think again: The deniers ask: 'Will we really be brought back when we are decayed bones?' (79:10 to 11). How would you answer?
questions.a: Allah who created us the first time can easily bring us back; it is 'but one shout' (79:13).
